LESSON: INSPIRED WORD OF GOD

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible
Topic 2.1: Inspired Word of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Inspired Word of God. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is the Bible different from other books?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain why the Bible is the inspired word of God
2. name three authors who wrote the Bible
3. discuss reasons that led to translation of the Bible into local languages
4. read the Bible always to get spiritual nourishment

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: INSPIRED WORD OF GOD
This lesson teaches Inspired Word of God for Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain why the Bible is the inspired word of God
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. name three authors who wrote the Bible
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. discuss reasons that led to translation of the Bible into local languages
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. read the Bible always to get spiritual nourishment
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Inspired Word of God using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Inspired Word of God above.
2. Explain Inspired Word of God to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Inspired Word of God.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Inspired Word of God with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Inspired Word of God important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is the Bible different from other books?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain why the Bible is the inspired word of God
2. name three authors who wrote the Bible
3. discuss reasons that led to translation of the Bible into local languages
4. read the Bible always to get spiritual nourishment
